eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Gavin Newsom as the 2028 Democratic presidential nominee frontrunner at 25% implied probability, driven by his proactive national profile-building, including red-state tours and criticism of prior Democratic leadership after Kamala Harris's 2024 election defeat dropped her odds to 5%. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez trails at 8.3%, buoyed by progressive grassroots energy and media savvy, while Jon Ossoff's 6.8% reflects his swing-state Georgia Senate victory and youth appeal. Differentiators include Newsom's executive experience versus AOC's ideological fervor and Ossoff's bipartisan wins; consolidation may follow 2026 midterms, fundraising reports, and intraparty debates on post-2024 strategy in this open primary field.

Holding a perfect 3-0 record with blowout wins over professional squads from Berlin (104-52) and Alberta (102-57), plus a preseason exhibition triumph over Duke, Arizona boasts superior size led by 7-foot center Motiejus Krivas and versatile guards like Jaden Bradley. Utah State sits 3-0 too, but against softer non-D1 and low-major foes, relying on transfers like Nick Davidson amid the loss of star Great Osobor. No key injuries reported for either side shifts focus to Arizona's historical edge in high-major matchups and rest advantage.
